name: Doomed Playtime [BETA]
desc:
Survive the night shift: solve puzzles, collect toy parts and evade the monsters awakening before the clock runs out.
---------------------------------------------------------------
“Doomed Playtime” is an unofficial fan-game, made with no profit intended. All characters, names, trademarks, and other intellectual property related to Poppy Playtime® belong exclusively to Mob Entertainment, Inc. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Mob Entertainment.
---------------------------------------------------------------
------ CONTROLS --------
Q - Blinding Flashlight
F - Flashlight
Left Shift - Sprint
C - Crouch
T - Help
----------------------------
For the best experience, we recommend playing on a device with decent performance.
Frequent lag, laggy camera shaking, or glitches usually mean your device is struggling to keep up with the game.
